routing.retry_policy: REVIEW_INVALID/REVIEW_REJECTED keep the candidate isolated; only REVIEW_UNAVAILABLE is a technical outage; S10 recovery replays the same persisted request and never regenerates the manifest

known_red_note: All three are WG3-AC-10 action leaks owned by #93: available_actions also returns analyze_reference/submit_request beside continue_workflow. They are not S10/S12 branch failures and are not used as pass evidence.

approval_results.normal_path: delivery_manifest approval is written only after reviewer pass; no approval exists while REVIEW_UNAVAILABLE
approval_results.recovery_path: same artifact id becomes approved; approval approved_by=output_reviewer and checks include asset_id, asset_digest, target_id, requirement_revision, ruleset_version
approval_results.invalidation: revoking the image approval blocks continue_workflow with 409 IMAGE_NOT_APPROVED before any reviewer call; manifest remains candidate and no delivery_manifest approval is written

results.resources: temp SQLite per case; no real provider network; no image generation; published byte checks use the local asset route
results.artifacts: S10 delivery_manifest candidate/approved; no extra artifact created by recovery

residual_unknowns: frontend rendering of REVIEW_INVALID/REVIEW_REJECTED and action visibility is #93
